specimens.title: Pyrite in host rock
specimens.note: Brassy cubes held in dark volcanic host. Light is the only polish this piece needs.

specimens.title: Vernon rhyolite
specimens.note: Pale groundmass with a quiet sparkle. Born from fire; left readable.

specimens.title: Polychrome jasper
specimens.note: Banding as a calendar. Similkameen stone near Princeton — the same drainage that feeds the heirloom wraps.

specimens.title: Banded agate
specimens.note: Horizontal bands and iron stain. Water wrote this one first.

specimens.title: The Creek Quartz
specimens.note: Double-terminated clear quartz: current on one face, crystal on the other. A specimen that stopped the stride.
